headline: 1 NEAR contract account surfaced (contract.main.burrow.near); no EVM hex addresses found; NEAR chain not supported by DeFiPunkd read API; archived GitHub repo yields no deployment artifacts.

findings.text: NearBlocks search for contract.main.burrow.near confirmed it is the live Rhea Lend (Burrow) lending contract on NEAR mainnet. Contract Locked: Yes (no access keys). NEAR uses human-readable account IDs, not 0x hex addresses. DeFiPunkd read API supports only EVM chainIds (1, 10, 56, 130, 137, 324, 8453, 42161, 43114, 59144, 81457, 534352, 11155111); NEAR is not supported.

Protocol website (lending.rhea.finance) was inaccessible (fetch failed). guide.rhea.finance/docs/contracts returned a permissions error. guide.rhea.finance/docs/rhea-finance-white-paper loaded but contained no deployed contract addresses. No canonical deployments doc URL found. DeFiLlama adapter code at DefiLlama/DefiLlama-Adapters projects/burrow.cash/index.js is the only known TVL reference but was not fetched in this run.

Both audit PDFs (blocksec-audit-signed-1.pdf and blocksec-audit-signed-2.pdf) in NearDeFi/burrowland repo loaded only as GitHub HTML index pages; PDF content not rendered. Firm: BlockSec. Repo archived Jan 12, 2023. No contract addresses extractable from rendered GitHub audit pages.

NearDeFi/burrowland GitHub repo fetched. Repo is a public archive (archived Jan 12, 2023, read-only). Contains Rust smart contract code. README includes only testnet example script variables (CONTRACT_ID=dev-..., ORACLE_ID=dev-...) — these are testnet ephemeral IDs, not mainnet addresses. No deployments.json, addresses.json, or broadcast artifacts found. No mainnet contract account IDs in the README or visible files.
Protocol operates on a single chain (NEAR). Multi-chain enumeration not applicable. NEAR blockchain uses a single named-account model with no EVM-compatible hex addresses.
NEAR is not an EVM chain; DeFiPunkd factory enumeration API is EVM-only. No factory pattern applicable. Not attempted.

Role taxonomy: contract.main.burrow.near is the primary pool/vault contract (lending pool). No admin, owner, proxy_admin, timelock, or multisig account IDs discovered from fetched sources in this run.

contract.main.burrow.near discovered from NearBlocks fetch (evidence index 3). NEAR account IDs are not 0x hex; cannot populate admin_addresses[] address field with a valid 0x address. Recorded in unknowns with D8 code.

rationale.verdict: Discovery run surfaced one NEAR contract account (contract.main.burrow.near) from NearBlocks, confirmed live and locked. NEAR chain is not supported by the DeFiPunkd read API (EVM-only), the protocol website was inaccessible, no deployments doc URL was found, and the source GitHub repo is archived with no mainnet address artifacts. Zero 0x hex addresses were found. Admin/owner NEAR account IDs remain undiscovered.

evidence.shows: contract.main.burrow.near is an active NEAR mainnet contract account for Rhea Lend (formerly Burrow Finance). Contract Locked: Yes. Self-deployed (creator = contract.main.burrow.near). Active transactions visible including execute_with_pyth method calls as of 2026-05-19.

NearDeFi/burrowland is the source code repository for the Burrow (now Rhea Lend) lending protocol on NEAR. Archived by owner on Jan 12, 2023 (read-only). Contains Rust smart contract, two BlockSec audit PDFs. README shows only testnet ephemeral contract IDs; no mainnet account IDs listed.
First BlockSec audit PDF exists in the NearDeFi/burrowland repo (733 KB). GitHub renders only HTML index; PDF content not accessible. Audit firm: BlockSec. Repo is archived.
Second BlockSec audit PDF exists in the NearDeFi/burrowland repo (730 KB). GitHub renders only HTML index; PDF content not accessible. Audit firm: BlockSec.
Rhea Finance whitepaper page. Describes Rhea as merger of Ref Finance and Burrow Finance. Lists RHEA, xRHEA, oRHEA tokens. Mentions DAO governance post-TGE. No deployed contract addresses listed.

DeFiLlama page for Rhea Lend. TVL $72.84M on NEAR. Hack on Apr 16, 2026: $18.4M exploit (all returned per DeFiLlama). Category: Lending. TVL methodology references DefiLlama adapter at projects/burrow.cash/index.js. Raised $5M (Mar 2022) from Dragonfly Capital, ParaFi, Jump Crypto, etc.

unknowns: D1: NEAR blockchain not supported by DeFiPunkd read API (EVM-only chainIds); on-chain view calls for contract.main.burrow.near owner/config cannot be performed via /api/contract/read
D2: No canonical deployed contracts doc URL found; guide.rhea.finance/docs/contracts returned permissions error; lending.rhea.finance website inaccessible
D3: BlockSec audit PDF content not rendered by GitHub HTML fetch; contract addresses in scope could not be extracted from blocksec-audit-signed-1.pdf or blocksec-audit-signed-2.pdf
D4: No mainnet NEAR account IDs found in NearDeFi/burrowland repo; archived repo contains only testnet ephemeral IDs in example scripts
D6: Factory enumeration not possible for NEAR (non-EVM chain); DeFiPunkd /api/contract/read unsupported

D8: contract.main.burrow.near is a NEAR named account (not 0x hex); cannot populate admin_addresses[].address with a valid EVM-format address; downstream EVM-oriented slices cannot use DeFiPunkd surfacer URLs for this address

protocol_metadata.about: Rhea Lend is the lending component of Rhea Finance, formed from the merger of Ref Finance and Burrow Finance on the NEAR Protocol. Users can supply assets to earn interest and borrow against over-collateralized positions in a pool-based model similar to Aave and Compound. The protocol runs natively on NEAR, with smart contracts written in Rust, and uses a dynamic interest rate model with open liquidations. As of April 2026, the primary lending contract is contract.main.burrow.near, which is marked locked (immutable) on NearBlocks.
